subject: ventures/consent-change-record
professional: a privacy engineer / DPO who runs GDPR and ePrivacy (Art. 5(3)) cookie-consent audits, in the CNIL style: what is read or written on the terminal before consent and after a refusal

evidence.correctness: Hand-built traces run through the shipped code (/tmp/claude-0/-home-user-oss-monorepo/1378d21e-81f5-5682-8b00-29e4997707f2/scratchpad/ccr/indep.mjs, `node indep.mjs`). Count semantics are right: a pixel 3 before / 1 after gives removed 2, unchanged 1, added 0 (C1), and repeated beacons collapse to one persisting row in the HAR tool. Three outputs are wrong against what a consent auditor (and HAR 1.2) would expect: (C2) the JSON comparator keys requests on the full URL including the query, so a GA4 /g/collect beacon that fires on both sides with a rotating _p cache-buster reports added 1, removed 1, unchanged 0 instead of unchanged 1; the sibling HAR tool already strips queries for exactly this reason (har-diff.mjs:39). (H1) the HAR tool's cookie diff reads only response.cookies (Set-Cookie); a _ga written by JavaScript and sent in request.cookies of later requests (HAR 1.2 request.cookies) gives addedCookieCount 0. (H2) the HAR tool is presence-only: a Facebook pixel 3 before / 1 after gives removed 0, persisting 1, the very case the vs-by-eye page says the product catches. Also: a site of 'https://shop.example' vs 'https://shop.example/' is rejected as a different site (C3); cdn.shop.example is marked third-party for a www.shop.example page (H4, exact-host rather than same-site).
evidence.completeness: `node --test *.test.mjs test/*.test.mjs tool/*.test.mjs` in the subject: 56/56 pass in 0.24 s. Claimed features checked: JSON before/after compare (works), Download report (code path present: Blob of reportAsText), refusal of cross-site pairs (works), HAR before/after diff with tracker grouping, persisting third-party list and JSON export (works on hand HARs), opt-out local count honouring DNT/GPC (usage.mjs:20). Gaps: the JSON 'trace export' has no capture path: no browser or tool emits that schema and neither README nor page says how to produce one, so the main tool needs hand-typed JSON; the report text never lists unchanged requests although vs-cookiebot.html says it reports 'which fire regardless'. served-copy.mjs: no placeholder origin left.
evidence.verification: 56 tests pass. 5 hand-seeded mutants via quality_mutate.py: 3 caught (count Math.min->max, tracker suffix dot boundary, persisting de-dup), 2 survived: dropping .toUpperCase() on the JSON request method (calc.mjs:8, so 'post' and 'POST' become different requests) and dropping the hostname from the HAR cookie key (har-diff.mjs:65, so a first-party 'sid' and a third-party 'sid' merge). No test covers rotating query strings in the JSON comparator or request.cookies in HAR input.
evidence.craft: Read calc.mjs (81 lines), tool/har-diff.mjs (163), tool/trackers.mjs (64), usage.mjs, tool/index.html script. Pure functions, HTML escaped on every innerHTML sink in tool/index.html (escapeHtml), stale report cleared on error. Defects: two independent diff engines with opposite semantics (calc.mjs counts occurrences and keys on the full URL; har-diff.mjs is presence-only and keys on origin+path); storage keys print with a leading space ('  -  _ga', keyFor at calc.mjs:17 with empty method); report headings hard-code 'ADDED AFTER CONSENT' even when sequence is 'after-reject-all' (C4b); HAR addedRequestCount is not de-duplicated (4 GA beacons -> 4) while persistingRequestCount is, so the headline counts mix units.
evidence.claims: Disclaimer (no warranty, not legal or compliance advice, verify) on index.html footer, tool/index.html:158, README and both vs pages; 'not a compliance badge' is repeated and honest; no-upload claim backed (no fetch/sendBeacon in calc.mjs, usage.mjs only writes localStorage). Cookiebot statements (CMP from Usercentrics, scheduled scanner, cookie declaration, auto-blocking, IAB TCF, page-count tiers) match Cookiebot's public product description as I know it, no price is invented (tested), and a not-affiliated line is present, but no source link backs them. Unbacked: vs-cookiebot.html:57 says the tool reports 'which fire regardless' (the JSON report lists only added/removed); vs-comparing-the-traces-by-eye.html:78 frames the counting advantage over 'two DevTools exports', but the DevTools (HAR) tool is presence-only (H2); llms.txt:5 says 'Results are estimates from the numbers typed in', template text that does not describe a trace diff.
evidence.fitness: Walked a DPO's job: capture a HAR on first load, click Reject all, capture again, ask 'what kept firing and what was written despite refusal'. The HAR tool answers the request half usefully (persisting third-party list, known trackers first, query-rotation tolerant). It cannot answer the cookie half for the most common trackers (_ga, _fbp, _gcl_au are set by JS, invisible to response.cookies) and has no localStorage at all; the JSON tool has the storage field but no way to capture it. An auditor would still need DevTools Application panel or a crawler for the evidence they file.
evidence.domain: Compared with ePrivacy Art. 5(3) and CNIL cookie guidance (Deliberation 2020-091 and its 2020 recommendations): the finding that matters is any non-essential read/write before consent or after refusal, of cookies and other storage. The tool frames the job right (observation, not compliance; the persisting list after a refusal is the right signal) but departs in where the evidence comes from: cookies only from Set-Cookie, no request.cookies or document.cookie, no first/third-party by registrable domain (eTLD+1), no IAB TCF v2.2 TC string or GPP/consent-mode signal inspection, and a 32-domain tracker list (misses licdn.com, sc-static.net, hs-scripts.com, run H5).

defects.what: HAR cookie diff reads only response.cookies (Set-Cookie). Cookies written by JavaScript (_ga, _fbp, _gcl_au), the usual pre-consent/after-refusal finding, never appear, yet the summary tile reads 'Cookies still set: 0' / 'Cookies appeared: 0'. HAR 1.2 request.cookies carries them and is ignored.

JSON comparator keys requests on the full URL with query, so a tracker beacon with a rotating cache-buster that fires on both sides is reported as one removed and one added, never unchanged; the sibling HAR tool strips the query for this reason.

HAR tool is presence-only: a tracker firing 3 times before and once after shows removed 0, persisting 1, the exact case vs-comparing-the-traces-by-eye.html says the product catches for 'two DevTools exports'.
The JSON trace schema the main tool takes has no capture path: no browser exports it and the README/page give no way to produce one, so the headline tool runs on hand-typed JSON.
vs-cookiebot.html says the tool reports 'which fire regardless'; reportAsText lists only added and removed, never unchanged.
Two seeded mutants survived: method case-normalisation (calc.mjs:8) and hostname in the HAR cookie key (har-diff.mjs:65) are untested.
First/third-party decided by exact hostname, not registrable domain: cdn.shop.example is third-party for www.shop.example.
Site check compares raw strings: 'https://shop.example' and 'https://shop.example/' are refused as different sites.
Report headings hard-code 'ADDED/REMOVED AFTER CONSENT' even for an after-reject sequence; storage keys print with a leading space from keyFor's empty method.
llms.txt says 'Results are estimates from the numbers typed in', calculator boilerplate that does not describe a trace diff.
Tracker list (32 suffixes) misses common tag hosts: licdn.com (LinkedIn Insight), sc-static.net (Snap), hs-scripts.com (HubSpot); disclosed as non-exhaustive and still shown as unclassified.

verdict: Does not meet the bar. An honest, local, well-disclaimed observation tool whose framing a DPO would accept (evidence, not a compliance badge; persisting third-party requests after a refusal is the right signal), and whose occurrence counting in the JSON comparator is right on hand inputs (3 before / 1 after -> 2 removed). But the evidence it collects misses what a consent audit turns on: the HAR tool sees only Set-Cookie cookies, so JS-set _ga/_fbp never appear (H1), the JSON comparator splits every cache-busted beacon into removed+added (C2), the HAR tool is presence-only despite the page's counting claim (H2), and the main tool's input format has no capture path. 56/56 tests pass, 2 of 5 seeded mutants survive.
